terms.gloss: a burning, heat, a glow; heat of feeling, eagerness, passion
evidence: Cic. Fin. 1.43: cupiditātum ārdōre restīnctō (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: at ubi caelum ēnituit et dēferbuit mare et ārdor ille perīculī dēflagrāvit
phrases.english: but when the sky had cleared and the sea had calmed and that heat of danger had burned out

sources: Lewis & Short: ardor
Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections, checked against the editions named there.
